title: What does treating reported target moments as known constants cost on a non-collapsible scale?
question: When MAIC or STC matches reported target moments that are themselves estimates from 100 to 1000 people, what does treating them as known constants cost in bias and coverage on a non-collapsible scale, where the moment-matched contrast is not the target estimand?
design: Successor to MIS-03 on a non-collapsible scale; every number in the protocol is generated from the registered design file and checked by script. Not yet run: the registered design needs about 668 core-hours.
